Apple's Standard EULA

Every TixPanda app is licensed to you under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement, which covers the license scope, warranty disclaimers, limitation of liability and governing law. The app-specific terms add details such as how subscriptions and free trials work. If they conflict, Apple's Standard EULA controls, except where the app terms give you more rights. TixPanda, not Apple, is responsible for our apps and their support.

Subscriptions, free trials and lifetime purchases (summary)

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID. A free trial, where offered, converts to a paid auto-renewing subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Deleting an app does not cancel its subscription.
  • Lifetime purchases are one-time payments with no renewals.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.

Ads

Free versions show third-party ads through AppLovin MAX and mediated networks. Buying Pro removes them. See each app's privacy policy for the data involved and your choices.
